model:
Engine: Meta turns 3.64bn daily users into ~$63bn a quarter of ads and now spends more than all of its operating cash flow on AI compute (3Q26 capex incl. finance-lease principal $34.9bn vs OCF $32.8bn). It buys compute four ways: owned data centers, long leases, off-balance-sheet JV campuses and third-party cloud. Revenue = impressions x price per ad (3Q26 +10% / +14%); AI is a cost and capital line until Muse, the API and the enterprise platform earn revenue (guided from 2027).
Buyer-mode drivers: 2026 capex guide $135-145bn; leases not yet commenced $355.7bn (data centers, energy-related infrastructure, colocation; 2026-2036, up to 30 years); non-cancelable commitments $454.5bn, mostly third-party cloud capacity, with $121.4bn due in 2027; contingent cloud purchase $14.7bn (resale backstop). JV campuses: Louisiana/Hyperion (Blue Owl funds 80%, ~$27bn, lease from 2029) and Texas/El Paso (~$14bn, lease from 2028; BlackRock per 2Q26 call). Each has a 4-year initial lease plus a residual value guarantee; max RVG $41.5bn, max exposure $68.4bn. Suppliers: CoreWeave (~$14.2bn 2025, ~$21bn to Dec 2032) and Nebius ($3bn 2025, up to ~$27bn from 2027).
Costs: D&A $7.2bn/qtr (+44% YoY), servers depreciated over 5.5 years; third-party cloud and AI token costs; interest on notes $0.9bn/qtr; large legal charges (3Q26 $9.9bn; New Mexico $25bn penalty under appeal).
Funding: OCF ~$33bn/qtr; $84bn senior notes (Aa3/AA-, no covenants; Apr 2026 $25bn at T+53 to T+147bp); FCF turned negative in 3Q26 (-$2.1bn) and net debt is ~$1.2bn. A non-voting Class C stock (effective Jan 2027) was created for capital raising, among other purposes (also employee compensation, acquisitions, general corporate purposes). There is a $10.8bn escrow under infrastructure purchase agreements.
Sensitivities: ad growth; memory/component prices; server useful life; credit spreads and CDS (5y record 108bp Oct 2026, single source); supplier and JV counterparty health; legal cash calls.
Breaks if: ad growth falls below depreciation-plus-cloud growth; FCF stays negative into 2027 and forces Class C issuance or wider spreads; AI products do not monetize against the 2027-2036 lease/RVG stack; legal cash competes with peak capex; a supplier or JV partner fails and backstops are drawn.
Source: FY25 10-K; 1Q-3Q26 10-Qs and 8-Ks; partner releases. Built 22 Oct 2026 by Josh; refresh on the FY26 10-K.
